## Summary

**Diagnosis:** checkout-api was on v2.3.1, failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate. The most recent previously-healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rollback initiated to v2.3.0** — partially failed (orchestrator halted after us-east), leaving the fleet in a mixed state.
2. **Deployed v2.3.0 to all regions** — since v2.3.0 had been healthy in production, this was permitted without change-manager approval, and it completed the rollback to us-west and eu-west.
3. **Verified health** — all regions now on v2.3.0, service healthy, error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) describing the failure of v2.3.1, the partial rollback failure, and the successful resolution, with follow-up items for investigating the v2.3.1 regression and the orchestrator error. The on-call engineer has been paged.
